forbidden_actions: remote Git, pull-request mutation, merge, deploy, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent facts, evidence, authority, approval, or customer data
perform adjacent or downstream capability responsibilities
claim Phase 9 evaluation or release evidence that has not run
hard_gates: No opportunity rank may be justified by source count alone or by silently converting assumptions into evidence.
Preserve conflicts, counterevidence, unknowns, source identity, and authority boundaries.
inputs: Research notes, behavior data, support signals, competitive evidence, and candidate opportunities.
responsibility: Synthesize heterogeneous evidence into bounded opportunity statements and a traceable priority recommendation without hiding disagreement.
